label: PF Backlog 552
title: CI2: PF_ID_ALLOC=strict default breaks CI (shared git-CAS authority unavailable in CI)
body:
## Problem
`config/env-flags.json` defaults `PF_ID_ALLOC=strict`; strict requires the shared git-CAS authority (`refs/heads/pf-id-counter`). In CI the ref can't be pushed/fetched -> `RuntimeError: ... refusing to self-reserve a local id block` -> lease/grooming/staleness gates + several tests fail.
## Fix
Run CI in a CI-safe mode (`PF_ID_ALLOC=on` soft, or fetch/enable the ref) in the workflow env.
## Acceptance
lease/grooming/staleness gates pass in CI; item-creation tests pass.
